sections.name: Mechanical / Pre-energize
sections.intro: De-energized inspection of frame, motors, harnesses. Catches assembly defects that destroy hardware or invalidate downstream measurements.

sections.name: Motor Functional (per-motor)
sections.intro: Exercise each motor individually — direction, speed, fault-status reporting.

sections.name: Multi-Motor System Behavior
sections.intro: All motors energized together. Coordination, fault aggregation, balance.

sections.name: Pressure and Airflow
sections.intro: System-level airflow verification with anemometer cross-check against firmware-reported airflow.

sections.name: Panel Integration
sections.intro: Premium and Basic control panel integration scenarios.

steps.brief: Inspect frame integrity, motor mounts, harness routing.
steps.criteria: Per assembly drawing; no visible damage; fasteners at torque

steps.brief: Energize each motor individually; verify rotation direction matches expected.
steps.criteria: All motors rotate in documented direction; no scraping or imbalance

steps.brief: Step speed command 0 → max via Fan Controller; observe each motor in turn.
steps.criteria: Each motor tracks command within documented response time; no overshoot or oscillation

steps.brief: Disconnect a motor; verify Fan Controller reports MOTOR n STATUS fault and alarm relay engages.
steps.criteria: Disconnected motor shows fault; alarm relay K1A/K1B per spec; ALARM_CODE matches

steps.brief: Command all motors to common speed; verify Fan Controller reports per-motor airflow.
steps.criteria: All motors at command; per-motor airflow within ±10% of nominal

steps.brief: At AI1 = 10 V, 5 min steady-state, compare anemometer reading vs Modbus QFAN_AIRFLOW.
steps.criteria: Anemometer and QFAN_AIRFLOW agree within ±10% of each other and within rated tolerance

steps.brief: Run Premium Panel scenarios per [fc_dvt] Section I cross-references.
steps.criteria: Each scenario produces documented MPF behavior; no panel-side errors

steps.brief: Run MPF at nominal speed for 8 h. Log motor currents, airflow, alarms.
steps.criteria: Zero unexpected faults; airflow drift bounded; motor currents stable

elaborations.text: Fan Controller DVT must pass on the controller installed in this MPF before MPF DVT begins. Controller-internal behavior is not exercised here.
